episode_title: 494. "Solkraft är nu lönsam i alla led" - Pascal Rochat, Active Solar
summary: Pascal Rochat discusses the solar energy industry transformation over 15 years, explaining how solar has become the cheapest electricity source globally and the leader in new power installations at 60%. He covers the Active Solar fund's journey, European and US market dynamics, supply chain risks, and the future of energy independence through renewables.
key_takeaways: Solar now generates electricity below 4 cents per kilowatt hour, making it the cheapest source without subsidies
Solar represents 60% of all new power installations worldwide and leads the energy transition
Fund performed poorly for 10 years (2008-2018) but has done extremely well the last 5 years as the industry matured
European solar market expects 70 GW new installations this year, with US potentially doubling to 40 GW
Companies across the entire solar value chain are now profitable with expanding margins
